name: Withholding Tax Rate Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of withholding tax rate.

BWIT.name: Back Up Withholding
BWIT.definition: Withholding tax related to payments subject to back up withholding.

FTCA.name: FATCA Tax
FTCA.definition: Withholding tax related to income subject to FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act).

NRAT.name: NRA Tax
NRAT.definition: Withholding tax related to income subject to NRA (Non Resident Alien).
